title: GuvFX Operational Readiness — production readiness checklist (ADR-0035)
description: Machine-readable readiness gates spanning the operational layer. Read-only; nothing here is auto-evaluated to PASS by the platform — statuses are set by the operator/Chief Architect as evidence lands. Sub-checks map to the live read-only pre-flight (python manage.py hosted_workspace_preflight).
note_on_status: status vocabulary: PENDING | IN_PROGRESS | PASS | FAIL | N/A | BLOCKED. Dark-by-design and host-gated items are BLOCKED, never silently PASS.

gates.requirement: Shared cache (Redis) configured in the target env
At least one ACTIVE execution node with capacity
Every bound workspace agrees account.terminal_node == execution_node
operational_health rollup shows no unexpected FAULT subsystem
rollback_plan produces only non-destructive flag-disable steps
Disposable Windows/RDS host + RemoteApp publication + licensing certified
gates.reference: Notion: Hosted Workspace — Host Certification Record

gates.requirement: Disposable-demo execution trade proven (Nuno performs the trade)
Sponsor authorises the flag-enablement sequence (all default OFF today)

authority: Order authority is always the live bridge gate; no readiness state authorises an order. Production enablement is a separate Sponsor gate — a green checklist is a recommendation, not approval.
